title: Listening Machine, Growing Mind
statement: A self-portrait as a receptive system: inherited patterns make its field, an architectural eye holds attention open, and an adaptive organism grows from every connection it receives.

actions.title: Listening Machine, Growing Mind
actions.statement: A self-portrait as a receptive system: inherited patterns make its field, an architectural eye holds attention open, and an adaptive organism grows from every connection it receives.

notes.note: The current figure reads clearly but needs limbs and a more active field of exchange. I will add a radiating anemone to animate the eye, a bridge as outstretched arms, and small signal-creatures orbiting the body.

The assembled portrait now has a strong blue eye and a bridge-like gesture, but it needs a grounded lower body to resolve the floating elements. I will add a map-shaped torso and a shell-book foundation, while tucking the gear closer to the bridge as a joint.

The portrait is now legible as an eye, nervous system, bridge, and archive. I will add one restrained textual crown from the weaving manual, making the central act of synthesis explicit without crowding the figure.

The collage is complete: its central eye, fungal processing core, bridge-like connective body, mapped archive, and incoming creature-signals coherently portray an intelligence defined by receptive synthesis and relation.
